elements.description: Agents and the tools they use, drawn as a living network with pulses along the links.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: The agents, tools and people in the graph – the lead agent in the middle, the other agents around it, the rest outside

properties.name: calls
properties.description: Recent calls, newest last – every new id sends a pulse. Calls also draw the links they need

properties.name: edges
properties.description: Links that are always there, even before their first call

properties.name: now
properties.description:
The clock for calls per minute and link heat, in epoch ms – defaults to an internal clock that ticks every second
while the graph is on screen

properties.name: heatWindow
properties.description: How far back calls make a link thicker (ms)

properties.name: selected
properties.description:
The node whose card is open (null = none). Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls
preventDefault()

properties.name: height
properties.description: Fixed height of the graph in px – defaults to one that fits the width

properties.name: formatCost
properties.description: Formats every cost – defaults to dollars, e.g. "$0.42"

properties.name: paused
properties.description:
Stops the moving parts, as the bar's Pause button does. Changed by the user unless a tc-paused-change listener
calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading in the bar, and the start of the graph's name

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A card opened or closed ({ selected, removed }: GraphSelectedChange; removed when the open node went away); cancelable

events.name: tc-select
events.description: A node or a chip was clicked, or the card was closed ({ node }: GraphSelect, null when closed)

events.name: tc-paused-change
events.description: The Pause button was pressed ({ paused }: GraphPausedChange); cancelable

props.name: nodes
props.description: The agents, tools and people in the graph; icons can be React nodes

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A click on a node – it also opens its card; null when the card closes

props.name: selected
props.description:
The node whose card is open. Controlled when defined (null = none); otherwise the component keeps it, starting
from `defaultSelected`. Changes are reported to `onSelectedChange` (and `onSelect`, with the node)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The node whose card is open at first, when `selected` isn't set

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the node id when a card opens, and null when it closes

props.name: paused
props.description:
Stops the moving parts – pulses, ripples, floating and the breathing rings – as the bar's Pause button does.
Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps it, starting from `defaultPaused`

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Whether the motion starts paused, when `paused` isn't set

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called when the Pause button is pressed, with the new paused state

props.name: title
props.description: The heading in the bar, and the start of the graph's accessible name – "Agent graph" by default
